description: This file defines a React functional component PromptCodeSnippets that generates and displays code snippets in different programming languages and formats for interacting with an API, based on user-selected options such as language and message type. It includes UI elements for selection, code preview with syntax highlighting, and clipboard copy functionality.

methods.name: showModal
methods.description: Sets the state to display the modal with generated code.

methods.name: generateCode
methods.description: Generates code snippets based on selected language, tab, and component props.
